description:
Create a Piping and Instrumentation Diagram (P&ID) for a chemical feed pre-heating loop in Wondershare EdrawMax. 

1. Launch EdrawMax (if not open) and create a new blank drawing or use a P&ID template.
2. Open the 'Industrial Engineering' > 'Piping and Instrumentation' libraries (Equipment, Pumps, Valves, Heat Exchangers).
3. Place the following equipment and assign these exact text labels (Tag Numbers):
   - Vertical Tank: 'T-100'
   - Centrifugal Pump: 'P-101'
   - Shell and Tube Heat Exchanger: 'E-102'
4. Create piping connections with the following flow:
   - Pipe from bottom of Tank 'T-100' to Pump 'P-101' inlet.
   - Pipe from Pump 'P-101' outlet to Heat Exchanger 'E-102' inlet.
   - Pipe leaving Heat Exchanger 'E-102' (terminating with an arrow).
5. Add the following valves:
   - Gate Valve on the line between Tank and Pump.
   - Check Valve on the line immediately after the Pump.
   - Control Valve on the line entering the Heat Exchanger.
6. Add a title text box at the top: 'Unit 100: Feed Pre-heating Loop'.
7. Save the diagram as '/home/ga/Diagrams/pid_unit100.eddx'.
8. Export the diagram as a PDF to '/home/ga/Diagrams/pid_unit100.pdf'.
